actions.text: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

dimensions.assessment: Affects commercial aviation manufacturers, operators, and the general public residing under flight paths in the United States.
dimensions.evidence: allow for the operation of civil aircraft... within the national airspace system at a Mach number greater than 1

dimensions.assessment: Alters federal aviation operating restrictions for supersonic aircraft over land, conditional on noise mitigation.
dimensions.evidence: so long as the aircraft is operated in such a manner that no sonic boom reaches the ground in the United States

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or clearly imply direct federal spending or revenue changes.
Requires the FAA to update specific federal regulations governing civil aircraft speeds.
dimensions.evidence: issue or revise such regulations, such as section 91.817 of part 14, Code of Federal Regulations

dimensions.assessment: Mandates permanent regulatory changes following a 1-year deadline for the FAA action.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this section, the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration shall issue or revise such regulations

missing_information: Specific economic effects on the aviation industry.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the FAA to issue or revise regulations allowing civil supersonic flight over land without special authorization, provided no sonic boom reaches the ground.
